information: This competition is a 2-day competition. Saturday's competition will be held in the Grand Ballroom and Sunday's competition will be held in the Prince George's Room. Both rooms are in the Stamp Student Union. Please note, as this is a college venue, there must be parent/guardian supervision for minors during the competition.
